instruction: Open the Drop Shadow dialog from the Filters menu.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent dismissed color profile dialog, navigated Filters > Light and Shadow > Vignette, successfully opened the Vignette filter dialog in 8 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate GIMP menu hierarchy, find specific filters in submenus, dismiss dialogs, interact with GIMP UI
metadata.task_rationale: Tests the same Light and Shadow submenu navigation but targeting Drop Shadow instead of Vignette. The agent must select a different item from the same submenu it already navigated successfully.
metadata.explanation: Task requires opening the Drop Shadow dialog via Filters > Light and Shadow > Drop Shadow. Evaluator quits GIMP to flush action-history, then checks for 'filters-drop-shadow' in the history file.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads GIMP action-history file via vm_command_line, which records all performed actions as action IDs
Postconfig correctly quits GIMP (Esc + Ctrl+Q + dismiss save dialog) to flush action-history to disk before reading it
Metric check_include_exclude correctly verifies 'filters-drop-shadow' is present in action history, confirming Drop Shadow dialog was opened
Parameter handling is correct: check_include_exclude receives the rules dict directly and accesses 'include'/'exclude' keys properly
Full coverage: the single instruction requirement (open Drop Shadow dialog) is verified by the action-history check
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The exclude terms ('error', 'failed', 'not found') are unlikely to appear in GIMP action-history (which contains action IDs like 'filters-drop-shadow'). They are harmless but unnecessary.
